title: 'Tis My Happiness Below
firstLine: 'Tis my happiness below, not to live without the cross; but the Savior's pow'r to know, sanctifying ev'ry loss.

lines: 'Tis my happiness below, not to live without the cross; but the Savior's pow'r to know, sanctifying ev'ry loss.
Trials must and will befall; but, with humble faith, to see love inscribed upon them all -- this is happiness to me.
Trials make the promise sweet; trials give new life to prayer; trials bring me to his feet, lay me low, and keep me there.
Aliens may escape the rod, sunk in earthly, vain delight; but the true-born child of God must not, would not, if he might.
